# oblique_user_profile (Data Source)

User profile is a singleton resource that's automatically created for all users and can be edited and managed separately.

https://google.aip.dev/156

As a general rule, information that is available when listing all users is on the User message, information that is only displayed when viewing an individual user's page is on the UserProfile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing user profile by its resource name. The profile is a
# singleton per user, so the name always has the form
# users/<user>/userprofile.
data "oblique_user_profile" "janedoe" {
  name = "users/janedoe/userprofile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Format: `users/{user}/userprofile`

### Read-Only

- `about` (String) Longer description.
- `create_time` (String) Create and update timestamps.
- `delete_time` (String) User profiles can only be soft-deleted to preserve logs and history. If this field is present, the user has been deleted and this profile can't be updated and won't be returned in lists.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'.
- `location` (String) Business location, such as "San Francisco".
- `pronouns` (String) Preferred pronouns. "he/him", "they/them".
- `reporting_chain` (List of String) Reporting chain of the user from lowest in the chain to highest.

["users/manager", "users/director", "users/vp", "users/ceo"]

Format: `users/{user}`
- `reports` (List of String) List of direct reports to this user.

Format: `users/{user}`
- `time_zone` (String) IANA TZ codes "America/Los_Angeles" or "Europe/London".
- `update_time` (String)
